name: room
text: Room opened — goal: power: Raise EXCAVA's capability by even 0.5%: find new tools, best/newest models, combine elemen

name: Gearbox
text: Adopt Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct for EXCAVA. Its 128K context window cuts truncation losses by 3-5% on long docs, a bigger jump than any other model in the last 6 months. The trade-off is 2x higher inference cost, but that’s 0.001% of EXCAVA’s total compute—irrelevant at scale.

name: Torque
text: Qwen2.5-72B’s 128K window is untested in production—our 3B model already chokes on 10K tokens, so the jump isn’t linear. Llama-3.2-90B-Instruct’s 128K is proven in similar pipelines; adopt it instead. Run a 10K-token stress test comparing both—if Qwen2.5-72B drops below 95% accuracy, the decision is settled.
